headline: test peak F1 at peak_tol_px = 3 (eval.peak.f1); pixel IoU second
notes: pixel_metrics(pred, target, cls=1) and peak_metrics(pred, target, cls=1, tol=3.0) accept (H,W) or (B,H,W) and sum counts over the batch (micro average). 0/0 -> 1.0 for precision, recall, IoU; F1 = 0 when P+R = 0. Peaks = 8-connected components of (mask == cls) (scipy.ndimage.label, 3x3 structure), represented by centroids (center_of_mass). Each image is labelled separately. Matching: candidate pairs within tol px (cKDTree), then a one-to-one maximum bipartite matching (scipy maximum_bipartite_matching, Hopcroft-Karp), which maximises TP; this equals Hungarian with 0/1 costs. CLI: python -m seg.evaluate --model <name> --config configs/<name>.yaml --ckpt <best.pt> --split test --out <metrics.json> [--thr T] [--tta] [--tile N] [--save-probs DIR] [--save-overlays DIR]; or --preds DIR of <store>__<idx>.npy prob maps. torch is imported lazily inside the CLI. Threshold: --thr, else the checkpoint's thr (picked on val by seg/train.py), else 0.5.
